description: This file defines the CsrfTokenManager class within the OrangeHRM system, which extends Symfony's base CSRF token manager to handle CSRF token validation using project-specific services and traits.

classes.name: CsrfTokenManager
classes.description: A custom CSRF token manager that extends Symfony's CsrfTokenManager to incorporate project-specific token storage and validation mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CsrfTokenManager with a token generator and token storage retrieved from the service container.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a CSRF token with the given ID and value is valid.
